title: Augtopus's Vanilla Enhancements Resource Pack
description: Resources for the "Augtopus's Vanilla Enhancements" modpack.
body:
This is a resource pack recommended for use with Augtopus's Vanilla Enhancements Modpack!

It adds a few features to the home screen, such as a custom logo 'Minecraft, Augtopus edition' many custom splash texts, and a panorama background that matches the 'Augtopus's Vanilla Enhancements' modpack!

![Home Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8fbd39ae283aa659b078c87d1cf4ce6e941adb6_0.webp)

This project should be added by default in my modpack in the future!
